title: Spicy Korean Sausage Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry made with spicy Korean sausage, noodles, and vegetables.
instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add Korean sausage and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add honey and cook for 1 minute.
Add mixed greens and stir-fry until wilted.
Add cooked noodles and stir-fry until combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
